- 25–55 min: Prompt review + routing demo (live editing and few examples)
- 55–80 min: Load test plan overview and a short ramp (10–15 min demo)
- 80–90 min: Next steps & success metrics / mutual action plan

We can cover the detailed checklist (network readiness, keys, test data) in a pre-read — I attached a draft agenda and a short network checklist.

- Wed Mar 10 — 10:00–11:30 or 14:00–15:30

Please tell us: 1) preferred slot, 2) attendees on your side and their roles, and 3) any constraints for doing a short live load ramp (e.g., IP allowlist window or specific test dataset requirements).

If those don't work, happy to offer a couple of later options. I cc'd Michael (platform lead) and Jasmine (solutions engineer) to support the technical pieces.

Thanks — looking forward to getting everyone aligned.
